description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/link-keyless-source-updatable: the keyless link never tested UPDATE or DELETE on the existing duplicate pair (2,'y') and (2,'z'). A new ACCDB host is made; LKN is linked (relative Connect) to NoKey of the input r-def-cat-txn-lksrc-accdb (rows (1,'x'), (2,'y'), (2,'z'), no key or index). Updatable and the Indexes of LKN are read; the rows are read. UPDATE LKN SET B = 'yy' WHERE A = 2 AND B = 'y' (dbFailOnError; RecordsAffected; DBEngine.Errors right before and after); rows read; DELETE FROM LKN WHERE A = 2 AND B = 'z'; rows read; UPDATE LKN SET B = 'both' WHERE A = 2; DELETE FROM LKN WHERE A = 2. The source file is read through an independent Workspace at the end.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
